message: 発足!! 流星生徒会
And so, night fell completely.
Well, reality is never that convenient.
In the end, nothing happened. Ria-senpai was sitting across from me, so our bodies didn't even touch or anything.
--Wait, what kind of shameless expectations am I having?!

name: Ria
message: 「Good work today ♪」
The lovely aroma of green tea...

name: Synn
message: 「Did you make this, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yup ♪ Here, enjoy \s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the tea. *sip*...」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Really? I'm glad \s04」
Sigh... As expected, Senpai can do everything, huh...

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for today. You were a huge help.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, the pleasure is all mine.」

name: Ria
message: 「To be honest, I didn't know what to do. I let things pile up, and it ended up like this.」
She can be surprisingly airheaded sometimes.

name: Ria
message: 「But thanks to you being here, Synn-kun, I got so much done \s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't the previous officers help you out?」

name: Ria
message: 「No... this was my responsibility, and the others are...」

name: Synn
message: 「Entrance exams, right? It's a crucial time for them now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」
Ria-senpai looked around the Student Council room with a lonely expression. As if reluctant to part with it, she gently touched the desk.
It was almost as if she resented the free time she gained from getting a recommendation...
Could it be that Senpai still wants to keep doing Student Council activities...?

name: Ria
message: 「Here, take this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Senpai handed me a card.

name: Ria
message: 「Since you listened to my request, I'm giving you a stamp card.」
Looking at it, there's a single stamp in the upper left corner.

name: Ria
message: 「Once this fills up, something good will happen. Eheh!」

name: Synn
message: 「'Something good' here, too?」
Ria-senpai's idea of 'something good'...

name: Ria
message: 「That's a s-u-r-p-r-i-s-e until every spot is filled!\s04」
Oh no, this is bad, this is bad!!

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks to you, Synn-kun, I finished everything I had to do. Shall we head home soon?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes.」
Shaking off my impure thoughts, I was just about to pack up my things when--
What is this bad feeling? My skin pricks, and goosebumps breakout all over my body.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, I'll walk you home.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh!」
Without thinking, those words had slipped out of my mouth.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, wait, do you already have plans with someone else?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No. It's not that, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「...Is there really no one else here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Nanaka is eating cake, and at this hour, nobody else...」

name: Ria
message: 「Does that mean... just the two of us...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, wait!?」
Hold on a second! What kind of bold move was that!?

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm sorry. I didn't mean anything weird by it! I just thought, letting a girl walk home alone at this hour is--」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah-ha. Look at my underclassman worrying about me.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Agh, no, I swear I'm not teasing you--」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm serious!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's okay. I understand♪」

name: Ria
message: 「So, how about I take you up on that?」
Side by side, alone with Ria-senpai...
*Glance*
My eyes keep wandering to places they shouldn't!!
What if things start getting... romantic like this...?
Aaah, my heart is pounding way faster than usual!!

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Wait, did my feelings actually get through to her!?

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai!?」
She suddenly tackled me to the ground!! Wait, is something good happening this fast!?

name: Ria
message: 「Shh, be quiet!」
Something seems off with Ria-senpai. I follow her sharp glare.
And then--

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth is that!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Gosh, why does it have to be now...!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, what is...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun... don't be scared, okay?」
Ria-senpai pulled something out from her clothes. It was a familiar item--the Rosary.
I thought I was the one who received the Rosary, though. Why does Ria―senpai―
Ria-senpai... naked... She stripped naked and transformed...
I just saw Ria-senpai naked!
Should I be honest and tell her...? Wait, no no no!
Well, Senpai didn't explicitly say not to look, so maybe it's fine--wait, that's not the problem!
But Ria―senpai... naked... her boo―

name: Synn
message: 「Aaagh...」
No, bad thoughts, bad thoughts!

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!」
I felt dizzy and wobbled.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry for startling you.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it, I mean...」
Once she confirmed that I was alright, Ria-senpai immediately turned with a dignified posture to face the strange creature.
It was something that clearly didn't look human in any way.
A visibly dangerous aura hovered around it.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm going to fight this Demon now, so stay put, Synn-kun.」
The tension was palpable in her every word. This clearly wasn't a joke.
But fight...? It's way too dangerous for a girl to do that alone!!

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahhh~」
That's why I need to clear my head!!

name: Ria
message: 「It's dangerous, so stay right there!」
At this rate, Senpai will be in danger... Get it together, Student Council President!

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a guy too! I'll fight with you!」

name: Ria
message: 「...Please do as I say. Hold the Rosary around your neck!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!」
I clutched it tight with all my strength. In response, my body surged with heat!
My mouth began to move on its own.
The words I wove were the melody of the battle to come--

name: Synn
message: 「Guiding my Lord, descending by ancient covenant: Avanshell, Angel of Pitch-Black Darkness!」

name: Synn
message: 「I... transformed...」
Don't tell me... I ended up naked too...?
It seems she didn't look at all.

name: Ria
message: 「Let's go, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ah, okay!」
